learning_objective: See that 5² + 12² = 13² by counting the unit squares built on each side of a right triangle.

definitions.meaning: the two sides that meet at the right angle
the longest side, opposite the right angle

steps: Here is a right triangle with legs 5 and 12 and hypotenuse 13.
The square on the leg of length 5 holds 25 unit squares.
The square on the leg of length 12 holds 144 unit squares.
The square on the hypotenuse, of length 13, holds 169 unit squares.
Add the two smaller areas: 25 plus 144 is 169.
So 5 squared plus 12 squared equals 13 squared.
conclusion: For a right triangle the two leg squares fill the hypotenuse square: 5² + 12² = 13².
